groups.A: Positive constant categorical predicates, drawn only from successful train procedure executions.
groups.B: A plus bounded greedy positive-preserving conditions selected to cover train procedure failures; schema domains only, no policy access.
groups.C: Complete declared business policy for this fixed procedure.
groups.D: C plus the same positive-preserving failure refinement. Hard policy constraints cannot be removed.

scope: Known synthetic policy and finite declared feature space; fresh IDs and held-out condition combinations, not new business semantics. Explicit experimental procedure executions supply train positives/negatives; they are not autonomous LLM trajectories. No model training or deployment selection. New-rule adaptation is a separately gated future experiment.
